title: "A map of major attention mechanisms"
subtitle: "An attempt to grasp them all"
date: 2026-11-24
categories: [attention, architectures]
page-layout: full
---
## Disclaimer

- This is a curated map, not a complete catalogue. There are hundreds of attention papers; I kept the ones that define a branch or that shipped in a notable model.
- Dates are the approximate month of the first arXiv version. Edges are my judgement of "builds on or is closely related to", not strict citations.

The zoo around attention keeps growing: sparse patterns, kernel tricks, SSMs, delta rules, hybrids. This page is a map of that zoo. Rows are families, the x-axis is time (first arXiv version, roughly), arrows mean *builds on / closely related to*.

```{=html}

<div class="am-controls" id="am-controls">
  <input id="am-search" type="search" placeholder="search a mechanism…" autocomplete="off">
</div>
<div class="am-wrap" id="am-wrap">
  <svg id="am-svg"></svg>
  <div class="am-tip" id="am-tip"></div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/d3/7.8.5/d3.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
const W = 1440, TOP = 56, BOTTOM = 16;

const FAM = {
  soft:   { name: "Softmax (quadratic)",           fill: "#85B7EB", stroke: "#185FA5" },
  sparse: { name: "Sparse / local softmax",        fill: "#AFA9EC", stroke: "#534AB7" },
  linear: { name: "Linear / kernel",               fill: "#5DCAA5", stroke: "#0F6E56" },
  state:  { name: "Recurrent state / delta rule",  fill: "#F5C26B", stroke: "#8A5A00" },
  hybrid: { name: "Hybrid LLMs",                   fill: "#B4B2A9", stroke: "#5F5E5A" }
};

const LANES = [
  { label: "Full softmax attention",   sub: "the O(n²) reference",          fam: "soft",   h: 80  },
  { label: "Cheaper exact softmax",    sub: "KV cache, IO, memory",         fam: "soft",   h: 100 },
  { label: "Sparse / local softmax",   sub: "fewer pairs, still softmax",   fam: "sparse", h: 130 },
  { label: "Modified softmax",         sub: "gates, sigmoid, differential", fam: "soft",   h: 120 },
  { label: "Linear / kernel",          sub: "O(n), no n×n matrix",          fam: "linear", h: 170 },
  { label: "Gated linear RNN / SSM",   sub: "fixed-size state + decay",     fam: "state",  h: 160 },
  { label: "Delta rule & TTT memory",  sub: "error-correcting state writes",fam: "state",  h: 150 },
  { label: "Hybrids in shipped LLMs",  sub: "linear layers + few full ones",fam: "hybrid", h: 140 }
];

// DATA-START
// [id, label, date, lane, link (arXiv id or URL), cost, description, shipped-in]
const RAW = [
["bahdanau","Bahdanau",2014.7,0,"1409.0473","O(n·m)","Additive attention for seq2seq translation: a small MLP scores the decoder state against every encoder state; softmax gives the alignment.",""],
["luong","Luong",2015.6,0,"1508.04025","O(n·m)","Multiplicative (dot-product) scoring plus global vs. local attention for NMT.",""],
["transformer","MHA / SDPA",2017.45,0,"1706.03762","O(n²)","Scaled dot-product multi-head self-attention, softmax(QKᵀ/√d)V. The reference every other node is measured against.","GPT, Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, …"],

["mqa","MQA",2019.85,1,"1911.02150","O(n²), KV ÷ h","All heads share one K/V head, cutting the KV cache by the number of heads.","PaLM, Falcon"],
["gqa","GQA",2023.35,1,"2305.13245","O(n²), KV ÷ g","Groups of query heads share a K/V head; interpolates between MHA and MQA with little quality loss.","Llama 3, Mistral, Qwen3"],
["mla","MLA",2024.35,1,"2405.04434","O(n²), tiny KV","Multi-head Latent Attention: cache a low-rank latent instead of K/V and up-project on the fly. On par with MHA when tuned, far smaller cache.","DeepSeek V2/V3/R1, Kimi K2"],
["flash","FlashAttention",2022.4,1,"2205.14135","O(n²) FLOPs, O(n) memory","IO-aware exact attention: tiled online softmax in SRAM, never materialises the n×n matrix. FA-2 and FA-3 improve parallelism and Hopper utilisation.","Default kernel in most stacks"],
["paged","PagedAttention",2023.45,1,"2309.06180","memory manager","vLLM: store the KV cache in fixed-size non-contiguous blocks like OS virtual-memory pages, nearly eliminating fragmentation.","vLLM"],
["ring","Ring Attention",2023.75,1,"2310.01889","O(n²), sequence-parallel","Shard the sequence across devices and rotate K/V blocks around a ring, overlapping communication with compute for very long contexts.",""],

["sparse-t","Sparse Transformer",2019.3,2,"1904.10509","O(n√n)","Factorised strided + local patterns so each token attends to roughly √n positions.",""],
["reformer","Reformer",2020.0,2,"2001.04451","O(n log n)","LSH attention: hash similar queries and keys into buckets and attend only within a bucket. Also reversible layers.",""],
["longformer","Longformer",2020.3,2,"2004.05150","O(n·w)","Sliding-window attention plus a few global tokens: the template for local attention in later LLMs.",""],
["bigbird","BigBird",2020.55,2,"2007.14062","O(n)","Window + global + random attention; shown to be a universal approximator and Turing complete.",""],
["streaming","StreamingLLM",2023.7,2,"2309.17453","O(n·w) + sinks","Attention sinks: keep the first few tokens' KV plus a sliding window to stream indefinitely without finetuning.",""],
["swa","Sliding window",2023.75,2,"2310.06825","O(n·w)","Local attention in a decoder LLM (Mistral 7B); stacked layers still propagate information beyond a single window.","Mistral 7B, Gemma 2/3, gpt-oss"],
["nsa","NSA",2025.1,2,"2502.11089","sub-quadratic","Native Sparse Attention: hardware-aligned, natively trainable mix of compressed, selected and sliding-window branches.",""],
["moba","MoBA",2025.12,2,"2502.13189","sub-quadratic","Mixture of Block Attention: MoE-style top-k routing of KV blocks for each query.",""],
["dsa","DeepSeek Sparse",2025.7,2,"https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp","sub-quadratic","A lightweight indexer picks the top-k tokens per query on top of MLA. Not strictly linear, but sub-quadratic.","DeepSeek V3.2-Exp"],

["sigmoid","Sigmoid attn",2024.7,3,"2409.04431","O(n²)","Replaces the row-wise softmax with an element-wise sigmoid (plus a bias); matches softmax quality and allows a faster FlashSigmoid kernel.",""],
["diff","Differential",2024.75,3,"2410.05258","O(n²)","Attention as the difference of two softmax maps, cancelling common-mode noise and sharpening focus.",""],
["fox","Forgetting Attn",2025.15,3,"2503.02130","O(n²)","Softmax attention with a data-dependent forget gate (FoX), borrowing the decay idea from recurrent models.",""],
["gated","Gated attention",2025.35,3,"2505.06708","O(n²)","A sigmoid gate on the attention output; reduces attention sinks and massive activations and helps stability.","Qwen3-Next (full layers)"],

["lintrans","Linear Transformer",2020.5,4,"2006.16236","O(n)","Swap softmax for a kernel feature map: φ(Q)(φ(K)ᵀV) with φ(x)=elu(x)+1. The causal form is literally an RNN.",""],
["linformer","Linformer",2020.45,4,"2006.04768","O(n)","Projects keys and values along the sequence axis to a fixed length k; awkward for causal decoding.",""],
["performer","Performer",2020.7,4,"2009.14794","O(n)","FAVOR+: unbiased random-feature approximation of the softmax kernel.",""],
["nystrom","Nyströmformer",2021.1,4,"2102.03902","O(n)","Nyström approximation of the softmax matrix from a small set of landmark tokens.",""],
["rfa","RFA",2021.2,4,"2103.02143","O(n)","Random Feature Attention: random Fourier features plus a gate for causal decoding.",""],
["aft","AFT",2021.4,4,"2105.14103","O(n)","Attention Free Transformer: element-wise gating with learned position biases instead of QKᵀ.",""],
["cosformer","cosFormer",2022.1,4,"2202.08791","O(n)","ReLU feature map with cosine re-weighting that restores a locality bias.",""],
["hedgehog","Hedgehog",2024.1,4,"2402.04347","O(n)","Learns feature maps that mimic softmax's spiky, monotonic weights, closing much of the quality gap.",""],
["based","Based",2024.15,4,"2402.18668","O(n)","Taylor-expansion feature map combined with sliding-window attention; explores the recall/throughput trade-off.",""],

["s4","S4",2021.85,5,"2111.00396","O(n log n) / O(n)","Structured state space: a linear time-invariant SSM with HiPPO init, run as a global convolution or a recurrence.",""],
["rwkv","RWKV",2023.35,5,"2305.13048","O(n)","Token mixing with a learned time decay (WKV); trains in parallel like a transformer, infers as an RNN with constant state.","RWKV model family"],
["retnet","RetNet",2023.5,5,"2307.08621","O(n)","Retention: linear attention with a fixed exponential decay; parallel, recurrent and chunkwise forms.",""],
["hgrn","HGRN",2023.85,5,"2311.04823","O(n)","Hierarchically gated linear RNN with learnable lower bounds on the forget gate.",""],
["gla","GLA",2023.95,5,"2312.06635","O(n)","Gated Linear Attention: a data-dependent gate on the state and a hardware-efficient chunkwise algorithm.",""],
["mamba","Mamba",2023.95,5,"2312.00752","O(n)","Selective SSM: input-dependent step size and projections with a hardware-aware parallel scan; constant-size state.",""],
["lightning","Lightning Attn",2024.0,5,"2401.04658","O(n)","Lightning Attention-2: IO-aware tiling of linear attention that keeps training speed constant across sequence lengths.","MiniMax-01 / M1"],
["xlstm","xLSTM",2024.35,5,"2405.04517","O(n)","Extended LSTM with exponential gating; the mLSTM cell has a matrix memory that resembles linear attention.",""],
["mamba2","Mamba-2",2024.4,5,"2405.21060","O(n)","State Space Duality: SSMs and masked, decayed linear attention are two views of the same thing, enabling a matmul-friendly algorithm.","Granite 4.0, Nemotron Nano 2 (hybrids)"],

["fwp","Fast Weight Programmers",2021.1,6,"2102.11174","O(n)","Shows linear transformers are fast-weight memories and points out their limited capacity, motivating the delta rule.",""],
["deltanet","DeltaNet",2024.45,6,"2406.06484","O(n)","Parallelises the delta rule over the sequence: the state is corrected by v − Sk, an error-driven write instead of a blind add.",""],
["ttt","TTT layers",2024.5,6,"2407.04620","O(n)","Test-Time Training: the hidden state is itself a small model updated by gradient steps on a self-supervised loss.",""],
["gdn","Gated DeltaNet",2024.95,6,"2412.06464","O(n)","Mamba-2-style decay gate α plus delta-rule update β: Mamba-2 improved with the delta rule.","Qwen3-Next, Kimi Linear (variant)"],
["titans","Titans",2025.0,6,"2501.00663","O(n)","A deep neural long-term memory updated at test time by a surprise signal, alongside short-term attention.",""],
["deltaproduct","DeltaProduct",2025.12,6,"2502.10297","O(n)","Several Householder-style delta steps per token for a more expressive state transition.",""],
["rwkv7","RWKV-7",2025.2,6,"2503.14456","O(n)","'Goose': a generalised delta rule with vector-valued gating.","RWKV-7 models"],

["jamba","Jamba",2024.2,7,"2403.19887","mostly O(n)","AI21: interleaves Mamba and attention layers (1:7) with MoE.","Jamba"],
["samba","Samba",2024.45,7,"2406.07522","mostly O(n)","Microsoft: Mamba + sliding-window attention + MLP layers.",""],
["minimax01","MiniMax-01",2025.0,7,"2501.08313","mostly O(n)","First large-scale lightning-attention LLM (456B MoE); one softmax layer per seven lightning layers.","MiniMax-01"],
["gemma3","Gemma 3",2025.2,7,"2503.19786","local O(n·w) + global O(n²)","Five local sliding-window layers for each global layer to shrink the KV cache.","Gemma 3"],
["m1","MiniMax-M1",2025.45,7,"2506.13585","mostly O(n)","456B MoE (46B active) reasoning model with hybrid lightning attention.","MiniMax-M1"],
["qwen3next","Qwen3-Next",2025.7,7,"https://qwen.ai/blog?id=4074cca80393150c248e508aa62983f9cb7d27cd","mostly O(n)","3:1 mix of Gated DeltaNet and gated attention over 48 layers; 262k native context.","Qwen3-Next"],
["kimi","Kimi Linear",2025.8,7,"2510.26692","mostly O(n)","Kimi Delta Attention (channel-wise gate, refined Gated DeltaNet) with MLA global layers at 3:1; 75% smaller KV cache and up to 6× decoding throughput reported.","Kimi Linear"],
["m2","MiniMax-M2",2025.85,7,"https://huggingface.co/blog/MiniMax-AI/why-did-m2-end-up-as-a-full-attention-model","O(n²)","The plot twist: a 230B model that went back to full attention. The team said linear attention was tricky in production, with weaker reasoning and multi-turn accuracy.","MiniMax-M2"]
];

const EDGES = [
["bahdanau","luong"],["bahdanau","transformer"],["luong","transformer"],
["transformer","mqa"],["mqa","gqa"],["mqa","mla"],["gqa","mla"],["transformer","flash"],["flash","ring"],["transformer","paged"],
["transformer","sparse-t"],["sparse-t","longformer"],["longformer","bigbird"],["transformer","reformer"],["longformer","swa"],["swa","streaming"],
["sparse-t","nsa"],["sparse-t","moba"],["nsa","dsa"],["mla","dsa"],
["transformer","sigmoid"],["transformer","diff"],["transformer","fox"],["transformer","gated"],
["transformer","lintrans"],["transformer","linformer"],["lintrans","performer"],["performer","rfa"],["transformer","nystrom"],
["lintrans","cosformer"],["lintrans","hedgehog"],["lintrans","based"],["transformer","aft"],
["aft","rwkv"],["lintrans","retnet"],["retnet","gla"],["lintrans","gla"],["lintrans","hgrn"],["s4","mamba"],["mamba","mamba2"],
["lintrans","mamba2"],["lintrans","lightning"],["lintrans","xlstm"],
["lintrans","fwp"],["fwp","deltanet"],["fwp","ttt"],["ttt","titans"],["deltanet","gdn"],["gla","gdn"],["mamba2","gdn"],
["deltanet","deltaproduct"],["deltanet","rwkv7"],["rwkv","rwkv7"],
["lightning","minimax01"],["minimax01","m1"],["m1","m2"],["gdn","qwen3next"],["gated","qwen3next"],["gdn","kimi"],["mla","kimi"],
["mamba","jamba"],["transformer","jamba"],["mamba","samba"],["swa","samba"],["swa","gemma3"],["transformer","gemma3"]
];
// DATA-END

// LAYOUT-START
const BIG = { transformer: 22, lintrans: 17, mla: 15, flash: 15, mamba: 16, gdn: 17, gqa: 13, mamba2: 14, deltanet: 14, swa: 13, gla: 13 };
function buildNodes() {
  return RAW.map((r, i) => {
    const n = { id: r[0], label: r[1], date: r[2], lane: r[3],
      link: r[4].startsWith("http") ? r[4] : "https://arxiv.org/abs/" + r[4],
      cx: r[5], desc: r[6], prod: r[7], i };
    n.r = BIG[n.id] || 11;
    n.cr = Math.max(n.r + 5, n.label.length * 2.6);
    n.fam = LANES[n.lane].fam;
    return n;
  });
}
const X = d3.scaleLinear()
  .domain([2014, 2017, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026])
  .range ([ 210,  290,  360,  450,  540,  620,  720,  860, 1030, 1380]);
const laneTop = [], laneBot = [], laneMid = [];
(function () { let y = TOP; LANES.forEach((l, i) => { laneTop[i] = y; laneBot[i] = y + l.h; laneMid[i] = y + l.h / 2; y += l.h; }); })();
const H = laneBot[LANES.length - 1] + BOTTOM;

function boxOf(n) {
  const w = Math.max(2 * n.r + (n.prod ? 8 : 0), n.label.length * 5.8) + 16;
  return { x0: n.x - w / 2, x1: n.x + w / 2, y0: n.y - n.r - (n.prod ? 4 : 0) - 3, y1: n.y + n.r + 21 };
}
function rectForce(nodes) {
  for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < nodes.length; j++) {
    const a = nodes[i], b = nodes[j], A = boxOf(a), B = boxOf(b);
    const ox = Math.min(A.x1, B.x1) - Math.max(A.x0, B.x0);
    const oy = Math.min(A.y1, B.y1) - Math.max(A.y0, B.y0);
    if (ox <= 0 || oy <= 0) continue;
    if (oy <= ox * 0.8) { const s = (a.y <= b.y ? -1 : 1) * oy / 2; a.y += s; b.y -= s; }
    else { const s = (a.x <= b.x ? -1 : 1) * ox / 2; a.x += s; b.x -= s; }
  }
}
function runLayout(nodes) {
  nodes.forEach((n, i) => { n.x = X(n.date); n.y = laneMid[n.lane] + ((i * 37) % 11 - 5) * 3; });
  for (let k = 0; k < 1500; k++) {
    nodes.forEach(n => {
      n.x += (X(n.date) - n.x) * 0.025;
      n.y += (laneMid[n.lane] - n.y) * 0.03;
    });
    rectForce(nodes);
    nodes.forEach(n => {
      n.y = Math.max(laneTop[n.lane] + n.r + 6, Math.min(laneBot[n.lane] - n.r - 22, n.y));
      n.x = Math.max(n.r + 10, Math.min(W - 60, n.x));
    });
  }
  // final pass without springs: settle any residual overlaps
  for (let k = 0; k < 1500; k++) {
    rectForce(nodes);
    nodes.forEach(n => {
      n.y = Math.max(laneTop[n.lane] + n.r + 6, Math.min(laneBot[n.lane] - n.r - 22, n.y));
      n.x = Math.max(n.r + 10, Math.min(W - 60, n.x));
    });
  }
}
// LAYOUT-END

if (typeof document === "undefined") { return; }

const nodes = buildNodes();
const byId = Object.fromEntries(nodes.map(n => [n.id, n]));
const links = EDGES.map(([s, t]) => ({ s: byId[s], t: byId[t] }));
const adj = Object.fromEntries(nodes.map(n => [n.id, new Set([n.id])]));
EDGES.forEach(([s, t]) => { adj[s].add(t); adj[t].add(s); });
runLayout(nodes);

const svg = d3.select("#am-svg").attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`);
const defs = svg.append("defs");
[["am-arrow", "#8a8a8a"], ["am-arrow-hi", "#0F6E56"]].forEach(([id, c]) => {
  defs.append("marker").attr("id", id).attr("viewBox", "0 0 10 10").attr("refX", 9).attr("refY", 5)
    .attr("markerWidth", 6).attr("markerHeight", 6).attr("orient", "auto")
    .append("path").attr("d", "M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z").attr("fill", c);
});

// lane bands + labels
const bands = svg.append("g");
LANES.forEach((l, i) => {
  bands.append("rect").attr("x", 0).attr("y", laneTop[i]).attr("width", W).attr("height", l.h)
    .attr("fill", FAM[l.fam].fill).attr("opacity", 0.09);
  bands.append("line").attr("x1", 0).attr("x2", W).attr("y1", laneTop[i]).attr("y2", laneTop[i])
    .attr("stroke", "currentColor").attr("opacity", 0.1);
  bands.append("text").attr("class", "am-lane-label").attr("x", 14).attr("y", laneMid[i] - 3).text(l.label);
  bands.append("text").attr("class", "am-lane-sub").attr("x", 14).attr("y", laneMid[i] + 12).text(l.sub);
});
// year grid
const ticks = [2014, 2017, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025];
const grid = svg.append("g");
ticks.forEach(yr => {
  grid.append("line").attr("x1", X(yr)).attr("x2", X(yr)).attr("y1", TOP - 8).attr("y2", H - BOTTOM)
    .attr("stroke", "currentColor").attr("opacity", 0.1).attr("stroke-dasharray", "2 4");
  grid.append("text").attr("class", "am-year").attr("x", X(yr)).attr("y", TOP - 16).attr("text-anchor", "middle").text(yr);
});

const linkSel = svg.append("g").selectAll("line").data(links).join("line")
  .attr("stroke", "#8a8a8a").attr("stroke-width", 1).attr("marker-end", "url(#am-arrow)");

const nodeSel = svg.append("g").selectAll("g").data(nodes).join("g").style("cursor", "pointer");
nodeSel.append("circle").attr("r", d => d.r).attr("fill", d => FAM[d.fam].fill)
  .attr("stroke", d => FAM[d.fam].stroke).attr("stroke-width", 1.5);
nodeSel.filter(d => d.prod).append("circle").attr("r", d => d.r + 4).attr("fill", "none")
  .attr("stroke", d => FAM[d.fam].stroke).attr("stroke-width", 1.5).attr("stroke-dasharray", "3 2");
nodeSel.append("text").attr("class", "am-nlabel").attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .attr("y", d => d.r + 14).text(d => d.label);

function draw() {
  linkSel.each(function (d) {
    const dx = d.t.x - d.s.x, dy = d.t.y - d.s.y, len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    const ux = dx / len, uy = dy / len;
    const sr = d.s.r + (d.s.prod ? 5 : 1), tr = d.t.r + (d.t.prod ? 6 : 2);
    d3.select(this).attr("x1", d.s.x + ux * sr).attr("y1", d.s.y + uy * sr)
      .attr("x2", d.t.x - ux * tr).attr("y2", d.t.y - uy * tr);
  });
  nodeSel.attr("transform", d => `translate(${d.x},${d.y})`);
}
draw();

// ---------- interaction ----------
const activeFam = new Set(Object.keys(FAM));
let hoverId = null, query = "";
const visible = d => activeFam.has(d.fam) && (!query || d.label.toLowerCase().includes(query) || d.id.includes(query));

function refresh() {
  nodeSel.attr("opacity", d => hoverId ? (adj[hoverId].has(d.id) ? 1 : 0.12) : (visible(d) ? 1 : 0.1));
  linkSel
    .attr("stroke-opacity", d => hoverId ? ((d.s.id === hoverId || d.t.id === hoverId) ? 0.95 : 0.04)
      : (visible(d.s) && visible(d.t) ? 0.28 : 0.04))
    .attr("stroke", d => hoverId && (d.s.id === hoverId || d.t.id === hoverId) ? "#0F6E56" : "#8a8a8a")
    .attr("stroke-width", d => hoverId && (d.s.id === hoverId || d.t.id === hoverId) ? 1.8 : 1)
    .attr("marker-end", d => hoverId && (d.s.id === hoverId || d.t.id === hoverId) ? "url(#am-arrow-hi)" : "url(#am-arrow)");
}
refresh();

const wrap = document.getElementById("am-wrap");
const tip = document.getElementById("am-tip");
nodeSel
  .on("mouseenter", (e, d) => {
    hoverId = d.id; refresh();
    tip.innerHTML =
      `<div class="t">${d.label}<span>${Math.floor(d.date)}</span></div>` +
      `<span class="b cx">${d.cx}</span>` +
      (d.prod ? `<span class="b pr">in: ${d.prod}</span>` : "") +
      `<div>${d.desc}</div><div class="h">click to open ${d.link.includes("arxiv.org") ? "arXiv" : "source"}</div>`;
    tip.style.opacity = 1;
  })
  .on("mousemove", e => {
    const box = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
    let x = e.clientX - box.left + wrap.scrollLeft + 14, y = e.clientY - box.top + 14;
    if (x + 310 > wrap.scrollLeft + box.width) x -= 330;
    if (y + 170 > box.height) y -= 170;
    tip.style.left = x + "px"; tip.style.top = y + "px";
  })
  .on("mouseleave", () => { hoverId = null; refresh(); tip.style.opacity = 0; })
  .on("click", (e, d) => { window.open(d.link, "_blank", "noopener"); })
  .call(d3.drag()
    .on("drag", (e, d) => { d.x = e.x; d.y = e.y; draw(); }));

// legend / filter chips
const ctr = document.getElementById("am-controls");
const search = document.getElementById("am-search");
Object.entries(FAM).forEach(([k, f]) => {
  const c = document.createElement("span");
  c.className = "am-chip";
  c.innerHTML = `<i style="background:${f.fill};border:1.5px solid ${f.stroke}"></i>${f.name}`;
  c.onclick = () => { activeFam.has(k) ? activeFam.delete(k) : activeFam.add(k); c.classList.toggle("off", !activeFam.has(k)); refresh(); };
  ctr.insertBefore(c, search);
});
search.addEventListener("input", () => { query = search.value.trim().toLowerCase(); refresh(); });
})();
</script>
```

## Cheat-sheet

| Family | Cost in sequence length *n* | What the model carries at inference | Representative nodes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Full softmax | O(n²) compute | KV cache grows linearly with *n* | MHA, MQA/GQA, MLA, FlashAttention |
| Sparse / local softmax | O(n·w) to sub-quadratic | KV cache (windowed or top-k selected) | Sliding window, BigBird, NSA, DeepSeek Sparse |
| Linear / kernel | O(n) | one d×d matrix per head | Linear Transformer, Performer, Based |
| Gated recurrent / SSM | O(n) | fixed-size state, decayed over time | RetNet, GLA, Mamba-2, Lightning |
| Delta rule / TTT | O(n) | fixed-size state, error-corrected writes | DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, Titans |
| Hybrids | mostly O(n), a few O(n²) layers | small state plus a small KV cache | Qwen3-Next, Kimi Linear, MiniMax-M1 |
